characters.name: Kulbrænderen Synd
characters.description: Kulbrænderen Synd is a robust and gritty character, dressed in tattered, soot-covered clothes. His face is weathered with hard lines, suggesting a life of laborious work under harsh conditions. He has a rough beard and tired, but kind eyes. Standing with a solid posture, he exudes a sense of experience and generosity. The setting around him includes stacks of coal and a robust fire pit, highlighting his profession as a coal burner.

characters.name: Smeden
characters.description: Smeden is a sturdy figure with muscular arms, indicative of his blacksmith trade. He wears a leather apron over a simple tunic, stained from the soot and sweat of his work. His hair is cropped short, and his face shows a concentrated, yet friendly expression. He often carries a heavy hammer and is surrounded by an anvil, a glowing forge, and tools of his craft.

characters.name: Bjørnen
characters.description: Bjørnen is a large bear with a short, truncated tail. His fur is thick and an earthy brown. In the scene where he stands on ice, he looks confused and surprised, with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. His posture is a mix of hulking strength and clumsy innocence. The icy landscape around him is highlighted with a hole in the ice where his tail got frozen.

characters.name: Ræven
characters.description: Ræven is a smooth and cunning fox with sleek, red fur and a bushy tail. His eyes are sharp and mischievous, with a sly grin usually playing on his face. Seen sneaking around a thick spruce bush, he is clever and always planning his next trick. In scenes where he's raiding the butter stash, he appears stealthy and pleased with himself, the satisfaction of his cunning displayed in his body language and expression.

characters.name: Vedhuggeren Øx
characters.description: Vedhuggeren Øx is a robust, middle-aged man with a strong, rugged build. His clothes are practical and worn, bearing evidence of frequent hard work in the forest. He has a full beard and a friendly, earnest face. With an axe over his shoulder, he often appears surrounded by felled trees and logs, symbolizing his life as a woodcutter.

characters.name: Bagstekonen
characters.description: Bagstekonen is a plump, middle-aged woman with a warm and inviting presence. She wears an apron over a simple dress, often dusted with flour. Her hands are capable and quick, reflecting her baking skills. Typically found in a cozy kitchen, she is surrounded by the delicious aroma of freshly baked bread and pastries.

characters.name: Træskemanden Lefse
characters.description: Træskemanden Lefse is a craftsman with a wiry build, capable hands, and a genuinely focused demeanor. He dons simple clothes with wood shavings often in his tousled hair. His workspace is cluttered with various woodworking tools, and carved pieces showing detailed artisanal skill.

characters.name: Purken
characters.description: Purken is depicted as a cheerful and somewhat mischievous figure with short stature. Known for his quick wit, he often sports a gently smiling face. Wearing plain workaday attire, he is found amidst bushels of grain, a testament to his vocation involving corn.

characters.name: Skomageren
characters.description: Skomageren is an elderly man with wiry spectacles perched on his nose, his posture slightly hunched over from years of cobbling. His attire is practical and his workspace filled with various shoes and an array of shoe repair tools. He often appears thoughtful and dedicated, with his hands deeply lined from years of meticulous work.

characters.name: Jomfru Maria
characters.description: Jomfru Maria is depicted as a serene and graceful figure, draped in flowing, modest robes. Her expressions convey warmth and compassion, with gentle eyes and a soft smile. She is often depicted in tranquil settings that evoke a sense of holiness and calm, a pair of glowing shoes in the background as her divine gifts.

characters.name: Linden
characters.description: Linden is portrayed as a mystical figure, slightly ethereal with a connection to nature. Her attire incorporates elements of gold ribbons interwoven with natural motifs. She appears tranquil and somewhat whimsical, often in forest settings under a canopy of leaves, adding to her aura of woodland grace.
